title: Friends
demoNote: Demo: these people are made up, and nothing leaves your phone.

signIn.heading: Read with Your Friends
signIn.text: Watch their gardens grow, encourage them, and read together in groups. You need an account for this.
signIn.codeSent: A 6-digit code is on its way to {{email}}.
signIn.demoNote: Demo: each button opens a trial session. No account is created, no email is sent, and nothing leaves your phone. Any 6-digit code works.

list.noFriendsNote: Add someone by name, or with your code.

friend.hasanatNote: Estimate: each letter read counts as ten hasanat, after the hadith narrated by Ibn Mas‘ud (at-Tirmidhi, no. 2910). Only Allah knows the reward.
friend.levelHidden: {{name}} doesn’t share their level or their reading.
friend.removeMessage: You will no longer see each other’s gardens. You can send a request again.
friend.blockMessage: They will no longer be able to find you, send you a request, or see your garden. They won’t be told.
friend.readHint: Opens the Quran where you left off.

add.title: Add a Friend
add.searchNote: Results show the name only, never the garden.
add.myCodeNote: Valid until {{date}}. Whoever types it becomes your friend.
add.shareMessage:
Add me as a friend in Jannatuk with this code: {{code}}
{{link}}
add.qrNote: Have your friend scan this code in Jannatuk, or scan theirs.

scan.title: Scan a QR Code
scan.instructions: Point the camera at your friend’s QR code: they’re added as soon as it’s read.
scan.notAnInvitation: This QR code isn’t a Jannatuk invitation.
scan.askTitle: The Camera Reads the QR Code
scan.askText: Jannatuk uses it to read your friend’s code. No picture is kept.
scan.deniedText: To scan a friend’s QR code, allow the camera in Settings.
scan.failedText: Another app may be using it.
scan.typeInstead: You can also type their code on the previous page.

group.weekNote: Pages read for the first time, Monday to Sunday.
group.monthNote: Pages read for the first time, this month.
group.addNote: Your friends join without having to accept, and can leave whenever they like. Every member sees everyone’s names and pages.
group.noOneToAdd: All your friends are already in this group.
group.notFoundText: You aren’t, or are no longer, a member of this group.

newGroup.title: New Group
newGroup.note: You will be its owner. Then you can add your friends to it.

refusals.name-forbidden-character: This name has a character that isn’t accepted.
refusals.request-already-sent: Your request is waiting for an answer.
refusals.request-declined-recently: You can send a request again in a few days.
refusals.invite-code-malformed: That’s not an invitation code: 8 letters and digits.
refusals.invite-expired: This code is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
refusals.search-query-forbidden-character: The search has a character that isn’t accepted.
refusals.too-many-searches: Many searches at once. Try again in a minute.
refusals.unknown: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
